signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a split-level house frontage from the street, with some tree shade and canopy partially obscuring the left side.

yard_sign.evidence: A small flat stone or marker sits at the base of the large tree, but it looks like a decorative rock or plaque and not a real estate sign.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched beds, a shaped shrub by the entry and a paver walkway are tidy, but nothing shows a crew or equipment, so this is probably homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: Well-kept split-level with a gravel and paver driveway and mature trees; a white object, possibly a trailer or dumpster, is partly visible at the far right edge behind the shed, but it is unclear and may be on a neighboring lot.
